title: Compound gear reducer
summary: A sealed two-stage spur gearbox that drives a 250 kg conveyor load at 0.45 m/s from a 960 rpm motor.
description: I selected the gears from a Boston Gear catalogue to approach the required 6.7:1 ratio, then sized the shafts, bearings, keys, set screws and seals with verification calculations at a safety factor of 2. The design delivers 73.6 N·m at the output. I modelled the full assembly in Inventor, with a shelled, bolted housing that clamps all six bearings, and produced dimensioned drawings for each part.
highlights: Required output of 73.6 N·m and 1.1 kW, with a safety factor of 2
Shafts, keys and bearings verified by hand calculation
Sealed, bolted housing with M8 mounting feet
